audit_metadata.scope: Full-system audit — architecture, security, database, API, performance, UI/UX, accessibility, devops
audit_metadata.method: 8 parallel read-only subagent audits against the local dev environment (/var/www/html/safari-zangu, MySQL safari_zangu, http://localhost/safari-zangu)
audit_metadata.note_on_scores: Per-phase scores were written directly by each phase's own report for Architecture, Database, API, Performance, Accessibility, and DevOps. The Security and UI/UX phase briefs omitted an explicit 0-100 score request (an error in the orchestrating prompts, not the agents); those two scores were derived afterward from each report's own documented severity breakdown, calibrated against the other six phases' score-to-severity ratios.
audit_metadata.disclaimer: No application file was modified by any audit agent. No destructive database statement was run. Two disposable QA accounts (qa_audit_bot / superadmin, qa_audit_agent / agent) were created solely to allow authenticated UI/accessibility checks and were deleted after all phases completed.

critical_issues.finding: Web root is serving leftover scan/report artifacts live (200 OK): folder_tree.txt, security_report.json (lists this app's own prior security findings by filename), project_inventory.json, system_audit_report.json, technology_inventory.json. .htaccess's extension blocklist does not cover .json/.txt/.png.
critical_issues.status: Confirmed live by curl; awaiting user decision on deletion as of report time

critical_issues.finding: Every .admin-label across admin/*.php (269 occurrences) and agent-portal/*.php (29/32) is a real <label> element never programmatically associated with its input (0 use `for`) — confirmed live on the Add Lead modal DOM. Public-facing forms use a different, correctly-linked form-label class, proving the team already knows the right pattern.
critical_issues.status: Confirmed via static review + live DOM inspection

critical_issues.finding: All 21 admin/agent .admin-modal-overlay dialogs have zero ARIA (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby) and openModal()/closeModal() never move or trap focus — confirmed live (focus stayed on the trigger button after opening). The codebase's own confirmDialog()/promptDialog() helpers in the same file do this correctly.

high_issues.finding: JS duplication between admin/package_edit.php and admin/quotation_new.php is far larger than the one guarded function (peDetectSeason) — ~20 near-duplicate functions, 9 byte-identical, 12 already diverged (calcTotals, calcItinTotal, fillDayPark, syncItineraryDays, renumberDays, peDayBlockHtml, syncIncludesExcludesCore, addDayActivity).
VAT/service-charge breakdown logic duplicated into the public confirmation view instead of reusing a service — untested.

PdfRenderer.php inverts layering — a Service includes six api/*_pdf.php controller scripts and swaps $_GET to fake a request. If the included script throws, the catch block skips both ob_get_clean() and the $_GET restore, leaving output buffering open and $_GET permanently corrupted for the rest of that request.

Booking::create() is out of sync with production — api/book.php's real INSERT has customer_id/country/adults/children that the model's create() lacks. The one test covering it passes while testing a path production never calls.

check_booking.php discloses full customer PII + financial breakdown via booking_ref+travel_date alone, no password — contradicting the app's own BookingTracking password model used everywhere else. Confirmed reachable live.
public/book.php?quote_id= is a sequential-integer-ID IDOR; any visitor can enumerate quotation IDs and see other clients' name/email/phone/country/price with zero auth.
get_setting.php is a fully unauthenticated settings-table oracle. Confirmed live: discloses the real bank_account_no. (Corroborates API-2.)
manifest_pdf.php has no OwnershipScope check — an 'agent' role account can pull every other agent's customer PII for any date. (Corroborates API-1.)

booking_reminders has zero FK constraints; 34 of 52 rows (65%) are confirmed live orphans referencing booking_ref values that no longer exist, evidence of a format migration that never cleaned up dependents.

analytics_events has no pruning/archival anywhere in the codebase and its only index doesn't serve the plain date-range queries admin/analytics.php actually runs (confirmed full index scan via EXPLAIN).
manifest_pdf.php missing agent-ownership scoping present on every sibling admin document endpoint — any agent can pull the full daily departure manifest for every other agent's clients.
get_setting.php is a public, unauthenticated, confirmed-dead-code settings oracle; live-verified bank account number disclosure.
Two synchronous dompdf renders (measured ~0.76s combined) run in-request before Mailer::queue() is called — the background-dispatch fix only covers the SMTP send, not PDF generation.
.admin-input and .search-bar input set outline:none with no :focus-visible replacement anywhere — confirmed live, zero visible focus ring on any admin text field. agent.css has no focus rules at all.

Public form inputs lose focus rings via a cascade bug: main.css defines a global :focus-visible fix, but forms.css (loaded after) re-declares outline:none on the same selectors and wins the cascade tie by load order — the 'fix' is dead code.
No aria-live/role=alert anywhere (0 hits across admin/login.php, agent-portal/login.php, contact.php, book.php) — form validation errors are not announced to assistive tech.

Deployment docs describe two incompatible hosting models (Hostinger shared-hosting vs. sudo crontab/root-owned paths). The one documented DB-backup mechanism may never have actually been installable in production; admin log-viewer panels read log files nothing in the codebase writes.
No backup coverage at all for uploaded files (supplier contracts, quotation PDFs, team/gallery images) — the one backup script is DB-only.

medium_issues.finding: ItineraryQuoteBuilder::build() is a single 465-line function, splittable along its own Step 1/Step 2 comments.
5 genuinely dead files confirmed via repo-wide grep + git log.
php/PHPMailer/ (7,243 lines) is a dead vendored duplicate — the app actually uses vendor/phpmailer/phpmailer via Composer.
fetchAll($db,$sql) is redefined identically as a bare global function in 4 admin files — a redeclare-fatal risk if ever combined.
Booking ref+date lookup SQL duplicated in 3 places instead of calling Booking::findByRefAndDate().
A plain 'admin' role account can self-promote to 'superadmin' — no guard compares acting role to target role, and AuthMiddleware special-cases superadmin to always bypass per-account restrictions.
CSRF check skipped when attacker sets payment_method=paypal_callback — unused/vestigial condition, nothing else sends this value. (Corroborates API-3.)
Same ref+date (no-password) ownership proof used in parallel with the password model; lower risk since amounts are server-computed, but PII exposure on the confirmation page.
No automated retention for activity_log; email_queue purge is a manual admin button only, never scheduled via cron.
Missing created_at/status indexes behind dashboard 'recent activity' widgets (confirmed type:ALL + filesort via EXPLAIN; harmless today at low row counts, will matter at scale).
commissions.booking_ref unindexed despite being joined in the agent dashboard widget.
bookings.payment_status unindexed despite being filtered on every dashboard load.
countries/locations use utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci while every other table uses utf8mb4_unicode_ci; confirmed this throws MySQL error 1267 on direct join (currently dormant).
packages.itinerary JSON duplicates itineraries.days and has verifiably drifted (one package has an empty itinerary array vs. 3 real linked days); views/packages.php already works around this.

packages.profit_margin_percent (stored column) disagrees with vw_package_profitability's live computation for 5 of 6 packages (0.00% stored vs. 100.00% actual); the dashboard reads the view so isn't fooled, but any other consumer of the raw column would be.
api/book.php CSRF check skipped when payment_method=paypal_callback, vestigial dead logic that currently only weakens the one public write endpoint creating real bookings.

record_payment.php reads amount_paid and the idempotency check before any write, no transaction/row lock — two near-simultaneous requests could double-credit amount_paid and double-send invoice emails.

process_reminders.php hardcodes the cron secret literally in source, unlike the other three cron scripts which check CRON_SECRET from config; mitigated today by api/cron/.htaccess (Deny from all) but a committed, unrotatable secret.
check_booking.php uses the weaker legacy ref+travel_date credential instead of the hashed Track Booking password the rest of the system was upgraded to use.
admin/analytics.php runs ~20 sequential full-scan queries per load, several using leading-wildcard LIKE that can't use the existing index — measured slowest admin page at only 1182 rows.

mod_expires and mod_headers are not loaded in this Apache instance, so .htaccess's 'cache images 1yr/CSS+JS 1mo' directives are silent no-ops — confirmed live via curl (no Cache-Control/Expires on static assets).
Static/seed package images bypass the ImageOptimizer pipeline entirely; measured up to 761KB/1920x1280 JPEGs with no responsive variants (lazy-loading is present, resizing is not).

Homepage 'View All Packages & Full Itineraries' button causes real horizontal page overflow at 320/375px (confirmed via scrollWidth: 382px vs 320/375px viewport) — a missing mobile override that exists for similar CTA-banner buttons but not this one.
Admin dashboard grid overflows ~20px at 1440px desktop because the codebase's own existing min-width:0 fix for this exact failure mode is scoped only to @media max-width:1024px.
Gold #c8963e on white computes to 2.66:1, failing AA at every level — used for required-field asterisks, breadcrumb links, and star ratings on nearly every public page.
.team-role caption (#9ca3af on white) computes to 2.54:1.
Row-actions kebab menu correctly sets role=menu/menuitem live, but focus never moves into the menu on open and there's no arrow-key navigation — a half-implemented ARIA menu pattern.
Filename-as-alt-text anti-pattern, both the PHP-rendered and JS-injected versions.
Missing alt attribute entirely (not even alt="").

vendor/, composer.json, composer.lock are directly web-fetchable (confirmed via curl: vendor/composer/installed.json → 200, discloses exact dompdf v3.1.6). .htaccess's directory-block list omits vendor/.
No monitoring/alerting (no Sentry/Bugsnag/uptime SDK anywhere); the site's own security checklist confirms the process is manual tail -f only, on a site taking live PayPal payments.

low_issues.finding: bootstrap.php defines sanitize() twice (one live, one dead-but-divergent, missing strip_tags) and a redundant e() wrapper.
process_reminders.php documents a crontab path that doesn't exist.
OwnershipScope (Service) depends on AuthMiddleware (Middleware) — minor layering inversion, only instance of its kind.
Login brute-force lockout is IP-based, not account-based.

dashboard_stats.php, itinerary.php, set_hero.php check $_SESSION directly instead of calling AuthMiddleware::requireAdmin(), so they never enforce the 30-min inactivity timeout; itinerary.php also returns HTTP 200 instead of 401 on failure.
Track Booking password passed via GET query string in links.
CSP includes 'unsafe-inline' for script-src/style-src, weakening XSS defense-in-depth (headers are otherwise present and well-configured).
Duplicate FK constraint on bookings.package_id (migration leftover).
Hard-deleting an admin_user silently nulls attribution on quotations/leads/custom_safari_requests/incidents, no name-snapshot fallback (unlike activity_log, which correctly stores actor_name).
accommodations.park_key is an unenforced soft reference to park_fees.park_key (0 orphans found today, nothing prevents one).
Inconsistent error handling — raw $e->getMessage() echoed to admin-authenticated clients instead of logging + generic message.
Inconsistent JSON response envelope across endpoints vs. the {success, message} convention used elsewhere.
No API versioning — a real near-term risk given the SZV_PDF_INTERNAL_RENDER self-include pattern silently couples multiple internal callers to one endpoint's $_GET contract.
Hero image setting queried from the settings table twice per public page load (duplicated logic).
PHP's default session cache limiter forces no-store on every page including fully public marketing pages, because session_start() runs unconditionally.
No cross-request cache for park-fee/accommodation/vehicle lookups; not currently worth building given low volume.
4 of 38 admin tables don't follow the .admin-table-wrap pattern — verified this doesn't currently break layout, but it's fragile/inconsistent.
.admin-table{zoom:.4} mobile fallback — a deliberate, already-documented design tradeoff, not a bug, but worth the team re-confirming it's still the right call.
.admin-btn min-height is 40px, 4px under the 44px touch-target guideline, measured across all captured admin/agent mobile buttons.
packages.php has a negligible ~5px horizontal overflow at 320px.
about.php reuses logo.jpeg as a hero image but gives it fabricated alt text describing a scene that isn't there — actively misleading.
Heading structure skips h1 to h3 (no h2).

Public skip-link has the same 2.66:1 gold/white contrast fail as A11Y-6; admin/agent layouts have no skip link at all — a keyboard user must tab through ~45 sidebar controls before reaching page content on every load.
No CI/CD; the existing 12-suite custom test suite never runs automatically before the manual FTP/SSH deploy.
storage/logs/ is unused scaffolding — actual errors go to /var/log/apache2/error.log (confirmed live, correctly non-web-accessible).
Log rotation is an unexamined OS default (14-day Ubuntu stock policy), not an application-level decision.
Duplicated .env-parsing logic between two files.

recommended_fix_order: 1. Remove or relocate the 5 exposed audit-artifact files from the web root (DEVOPS-1) — trivial, same-day, highest information-disclosure risk of the whole audit.

2. Add ARIA (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby) and real focus-trap/focus-move to every .admin-modal-overlay dialog (A11Y-2) — the codebase's own confirmDialog()/promptDialog() helpers already show the correct pattern to extend.
3. Associate every .admin-label with its input via for/id across admin/*.php and agent-portal/*.php (A11Y-1) — mechanical but 269+29 occurrences, worth scripting.
4. Retire api/check_booking.php or require the same BookingTracking password check every sibling tracking endpoint uses (SEC-1).
5. Fix the public/book.php?quote_id= IDOR — require a token/password the same way the booking tracking flow does (SEC-2).
6. Delete or admin-gate api/get_setting.php — confirmed dead code with a live bank-account disclosure (SEC-4 / API-2).
7. Add the OwnershipScope check to api/manifest_pdf.php that all 7 sibling document endpoints already have (SEC-5 / API-1).
8. Add a role-comparison guard to admin/users.php so a plain admin cannot self-promote to superadmin (SEC-3).
9. Clean up the 34 orphaned booking_reminders rows and add the missing FK constraint (DB-1).
10. Add a pruning/archival job for analytics_events and an index that actually serves its date-range queries (DB-2).
11. Move PDF generation off the synchronous request path in api/book.php, api/convert_quotation.php, api/quotation_email.php — queue it the same way email sending was already fixed (PERF-1).
12. Fix the PdfRenderer.php exception path so a thrown error can't leave output buffering open and $_GET corrupted for the rest of the request (ARCH-4).
13. Fix the two confirmed mobile overflow bugs — homepage CTA button and admin dashboard grid at 1440px (UIUX-1, UIUX-2) — both have an existing pattern elsewhere in the codebase to extend.
14. Restore working focus-visible outlines on admin/agent form inputs and fix the forms.css cascade bug hiding the public-site fix (A11Y-3, A11Y-4).
15. Add aria-live/role=alert to login and public form error messages (A11Y-5).
16. Reconcile the two incompatible deployment/hosting docs and verify the DB backup mechanism they describe actually runs in production (DEVOPS-2); add file-storage backup coverage (DEVOPS-3).
17. Add a transaction/row lock around the amount_paid idempotency check in api/record_payment.php to close the double-credit race window (API-4).

18. Decide, as a product/architecture call, whether to formally de-duplicate the ~20 near-diverged JS functions across admin/package_edit.php and admin/quotation_new.php, or extend JsPricingConsistencyTest.php's drift-guard to cover them (ARCH-1) — largest single maintainability risk found, but not a live bug today.
